_comment: Numbers typed by hand, for platforms whose analytics APIs are gated.
TikTok and LinkedIn both put analytics behind developer programme approval,
and TikTok's is tied to a business account that cannot be switched on.
Meta needs app review before the Graph API returns Page or Instagram
insights. Until those clear, these numbers come off each platform's own
Leave a metric out entirely rather than guessing it. A missing metric reads
as 'no data' everywhere in this system. A guessed one becomes a trend line
The date is the day the numbers were read, not the day they were typed.
